reuse.why: Uses the existing recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and applyWeekendRule helpers, so weekend handling (including skipping daily occurrences) comes from the shared rule.

duplication.why: The RSchedule construction, try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper and map-applyWeekendRule-filter-null chain mirror getUpcomingDates next to it; small and idiomatic but not factored.

placement.why: New handler sits in schedules/app.ts next to schedule/get-upcoming-dates and is registered the same way.

scope.why: Only the handler, its registration/type and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Short, commented (window padding explained), relies on the single weekend rule; easy to own.

disguised_duplication.where: The occurrence-to-adjusted-day pipeline repeats getUpcomingDates openly rather than in a disguised form; the weekend logic itself is shared.
